# Mathematics and manuscript requirements

- Separate established mathematics, framework-specific constructions, and
  proposed contributions.
- State definitions and assumptions explicitly; prove necessity and
  sufficiency separately when relevant.
- Preserve source provenance and map formal results to manuscript identifiers
  only when the mapping is verified.
- Expose countermodels, axioms, and unproved obligations; compilation alone is
  not mathematical or external validation.
